name: Runner Extras - Query FlowField Column
brief: Regression for issue #2428: a query column over a FlowField could not be opened. BC builds a sub-query for the FlowField while creating the query metadata and reads NCLMetaTable.SqlTableName, whose NavSqlStatementHelper.ConvertToSqlIdentifier dereferenced the null NavGlobal.AppDatabase on the runner's skeleton session.
description: The BC-language contract this exercises - a query column over a FlowField carries the calculated value - is a plain BC-behaviour claim and belongs upstream in the al-language corpus (see the runner repo's bc-behavior-tests-go-upstream.md); the shape was measured green on a real BC 28.4 service tier before the issue was filed. This suite is the runner-repo-local stopgap so this repo's own CI gates the fix now; once the corpus test lands and the pin moves it may be retired.
